name: preview_sink
description: Keeps the latest record a script surfaces via xi::use("preview").process(...) and returns it on exchange_instance({"command":"get_latest"}). The post-VAR way to view script output: data flows script -> plugin -> client pull, no core vars frame.

inputs.name: any
inputs.doc: whatever the script wants to view (data + images)

exchange.doc: returns {seen, data, image_count} of the most recent surfaced record
